_about: A WOOD ANTS' MOUND (ants.js): a dome of pine needles and twigs at a forest's edge or in a clearing, its ants milling over it and walking their trails out into the grass by day in fair weather. R: its radius (m), H: its height (m), each a [least, most] the world picks from; n: how many in a world; needle/dark/litter: its colours; ants: mound (ants on it), trail (ants on its trails), trails [least, most], reach (a trail's length, m), size (an ant's card, m), speed (m/s), far (drawn within, m). (2026-11-08) Drawn larger than life past a metre from the eye but at most 2.5 times (ants.js ANTS.grow, a ~2.8 cm ant: uncapped, a trail's ants 8 m off were 10 cm), so far 16 (was 28): beyond it they are specks.
